Composition is JIS Korean's deterministic engine, with no prediction: a vowel with no initial gets an implied ㅇ (ㅏ → 아), a vowel after a final takes it (화면 ㅣ → 화며니), and the same vowel flick again puts the final back (화며니 → 화면이). 확정 commits, dropping an implied ㅇ (ㅏ → ㅏ). Side columns as in Gboard's 12-key: ↺ undoes the last gesture, ‹ › move the cursor (and end a multi-tap), ⌫ deletes one jamo. 한A1 and 🌐 are drawn only.
